Name: Replace Cat Sound With Rabbit Sound
Author: NexusModsUser92384
Description:
Replaces the sound the pet cat makes with the sound rabbits make when they are pet.

The intended use is alongside a mod that replaces the pet cat with a pet rabbit. However, all this mod does is replace the cat sound, so it should work with any pet cat replacement that doesn't change the pet cat sound itself. It'll also work with the vanilla pet cats if you want them to have the rabbit sound.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9674]PurpleChickadee's Pet Rabbit mod[/url]. As that mod is currently hidden, you may want to simply use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25216]my Pet Bunny Rabbit mod[/url], which gives you a pet rabbit that doesn't meow, but sadly only works for Stardew 1.6.0+.
